title: Potion sizes and bag stacks
changes: Healing and mana potions now come in three sizes: Minor (40 HP / 30 mana), Medium (90 / 60) and Greater (180 / 120). Stronger monsters and chests drop bigger ones.
Q and V always drink your smallest potion first, so the big ones are kept for hard fights.
Potions are picked up into your bag and stack 10 per slot. There is no longer a limit of 5.
Old Morwen sells Minor and Medium potions, one at a time or 5 at a time.
